approve.title: Approve and hold the vehicle?
approve.effect: Approving holds the vehicle calendar and locks in the price. The booking is created once the customer pays in full; a trip with no hold payment is created right away.
approve.deliveryNote: This request asks for delivery. The booking starts with a 0₫ delivery fee — update it on the booking once you agree with the guest.
approve.scheduleConflict: The vehicle is already booked for this period — pick another pickup time or reject the request.

longTerm.title: Approve & hold — long-term rental
longTerm.legacyPackageHint: This request was submitted before packages existed, so it carries none. Pick the package you agreed with the guest — the system deliberately does not infer one from the old date range.
longTerm.pickupPlaceholder: Choose the pickup date and time
longTerm.pickupHint: You can only pick within what the guest asked for. For any other date, reject the request and agree on a new one with them.
longTerm.returnHint: The booking lasts exactly as long as the package the guest bought — it cannot be edited by hand.
longTerm.quoteUnavailable: Could not load the package price — check this vehicle's long-term pricing before approving.
longTerm.wishLegacy: Legacy request — the guest did not state a preference

pickup.estimatedDistance: The delivery distance is about {distance} one way. The fee above is an ESTIMATE from the shop's price list — the owner confirms it when approving your request.
pickup.manualWithDistance: Your address is about {distance} one way from the pickup point, outside the automatic quote range. The owner will discuss the delivery fee with you directly.
pickup.addressNotFound: We could not locate this address on the map. Try adding more detail (street number, street name, ward) to see the estimated delivery fee.
pickup.addressNotFoundTitle: We could not find this address
pickup.outsideRadiusRoad: Your address is about {distance} by road (one way) from the pickup point, beyond the host’s {radius} automatic quote range.

pickup.outsideRadiusUnknown: Your address is outside the host’s automatic quote range.
pickup.routeUnavailableTitle: We could not estimate the distance
pickup.routeUnavailableBody: The map could not find a driving route to this address, so there is no estimated distance or fee yet.
pickup.stillCanSubmit: You can still send the request — the host will contact you to confirm whether they can deliver and at what cost.

otp.loginHint: A 6-digit code has been sent to {phone}. Enter it to sign in — your account keeps your verified licence for all future trips.
otp.notSentHint: Tap “Send code” to receive a 6-digit code by SMS at {phone}.
otp.testCodeHint: Test environment — enter the test code to verify without sending an SMS.

price.deliveryNote: The delivery fee is not included in the total above.
price.loadError: We couldn't load the estimate. You can still continue; the host will confirm the price.

done.title: Request sent
done.body: The host is reviewing it. You'll get a notification as soon as they reply.
done.pendingBody: The host is reviewing it and will reply within {hours} hours at most — the closer the pick-up time, the shorter the response deadline. You'll get a notification as soon as there's an answer!
done.notReserved: The car is not held yet — the host has to accept your request first.
done.autoAccepted: Your trip was accepted automatically — the vehicle is reserved for you.
done.holdLoadFailed: Could not load the payment code. Open the trip under My trips to get it — your slot is still held.
done.heldSubtitle: Pay the reservation amount before the timer runs out to lock it in.

duplicate.title: Duplicate request
duplicate.body: You already sent a request for this car with the same period. Please wait for the host to reply before sending another one.

longTerm.noPrice: This car has no long-term price listed yet — the host will quote after receiving your request.

hint.within_7_days: The host will confirm the exact pick-up date and time within the next 7 days.
hint.specific_date: The host will confirm the pick-up time.

shopAccount.title: Shop accounts cannot book vehicles
shopAccount.body: You are signed in to a shop account. To rent a vehicle, sign in with a renter account using a DIFFERENT PHONE NUMBER — each phone number belongs to exactly one account.

ownVehicle.title: This is your own vehicle
ownVehicle.body: This vehicle belongs to your own shop, so you cannot book it. To reserve it for personal use, block the dates in Vehicle calendar instead.

shopNotAccepting.title: This shop is not accepting your request
shopNotAccepting.body: The shop that owns this vehicle is not accepting booking requests from your account at the moment. You can still book vehicles from other shops on XePrime.

address.vehicleAt: The car is in {province}. Type an address, then pick it from the suggestions.

licence.title: Verify your driving licence

reviewPage.title: Review your rental request
reviewPage.description: Check your trip and contact details before sending the request.

trip.selfPickup: Pick up and return the car at the owner's location
trip.selfPickupPending: The owner sends the exact pick-up address when confirming the trip.

renter.name: Full name
renter.notePlaceholder: E.g. I need directions for picking up the car
renter.readonlyDescription: The name and phone number the owner uses to contact you about this trip.
renter.phoneDifferent: This contact number is not verified — the owner will also see your account number {accountPhone}.

requirements.title: Documents & pick-up conditions
requirements.licenceBody: The driver needs a valid licence that covers this vehicle type. Bring your licence and an ID so the owner can check them at hand-over.
requirements.licenceVerified: Your licence is valid for this trip
requirements.driverBody: The owner's driver does the driving, so you don't need a driving licence. Bring an ID for the check at pick-up.
requirements.reminder: Verification and the exact documents required are explained under the current policy before pick-up.

costs.title: Rental cost
costs.totalNote: Includes the items above. The holding payment is deducted from this total; the security deposit is paid separately at pick-up.
costs.listedNote: We couldn't load the price for this trip — these are the listed rates. The owner confirms the price when approving the request.
costs.remainingNote: Pay the remaining amount to the owner before pickup!

others.title: Other payments
others.assetBody: Leave one of the following at pick-up: {assets}. Returned when you bring the car back.
others.noDepositBody: This car needs no security deposit at pick-up.

submit.hint: Complete your details and accept the terms to send. Nothing is charged at this step.
submit.agreementRequired: Please accept the terms before sending your request.

next.title: After you send the request
next.instant: This car supports Instant Book: your request is accepted automatically and you go straight to paying the holding amount to lock in the trip.
next.instantConfirmed: This car supports Instant Book: your request is accepted automatically and the trip is confirmed as soon as you send it — there is no online payment step.
next.hold: The owner reviews and responds to your request. Once they accept, you have up to {minutes} minutes to pay the holding amount (less if pick-up is soon) — the trip is confirmed only when XePrime receives it in full.
next.general: XePrime or the owner will contact you to check your details, confirm the car's condition and guide you through the next step. The trip is confirmed only after those steps are completed.

nearPickup.title: You are booking close to pickup time
nearPickup.noFreeCancelTitle: This trip has no free-cancellation window
nearPickup.short: If the owner accepts right away, you will have about {payment} to pay the reservation payment. Once your payment succeeds, you can cancel for free for about {freeCancel}. The closer to pick-up you pay, the shorter the free-cancellation window.
nearPickup.noFreeCancel: If the owner accepts right away, you will have about {payment} to pay the reservation payment and there is no free-cancellation window: cancelling after you pay only refunds the insurance (if any).
nearPickup.tooShort: Pickup is too close to pay the reservation payment through XePrime in time — the owner may not be able to accept this trip. Please pick a later pickup time.
nearPickup.estimate: This is an estimate; the exact payment deadline appears as soon as the owner accepts, and the free-cancellation deadline once you have paid.

check.signInTitle: Sign in to send your request
check.signInBody: Your trip is kept as is — sign in or create an account to review and send your rental request.
check.invalid: The trip details are not valid. Please choose again on the car page.

flow.tripNeedsFix: These rental dates can’t be used — please adjust them and tap Rent again.

approved.title: Booking created
approved.lead: The request is approved and the booking is created. The vehicle schedule is now held for this period.
approved.leadLongTerm: The request is approved and the long-term booking is created on the schedule you just set.
approved.next: Next: contact the renter to agree on a pick-up time, collect the deposit if any, then confirm handover right on the booking.
approved.holdLead: The schedule is held and the payment code has been sent to the guest. The booking opens automatically once XePrime receives the reservation amount.
approved.holdNext: The guest has up to 2 hours to transfer (less if pick-up is soon). If the money does not arrive, the slot is released and you get a notification.

deadline.label: Response deadline
deadline.pastDueHint: This request closed itself because its response deadline passed. Call the customer if you still want the trip.
deadline.hint: The response deadline depends on how soon pick-up is: at least 15 minutes, at most 4 hours. After that the request closes itself and the customer is told to pick another vehicle.

cancel.title: Cancel an accepted trip

effects.vehicle: The vehicle goes back on the marketplace and these dates reopen.
effects.customer: The guest is notified, with the reason you write below.
effects.money: Any reservation payment the guest has made is refunded in full.
effects.metrics: This cancellation counts against your accepted-and-kept rate.
effects.metricsHint: A trip you accepted and then cancelled is taken back out of the accepted-and-kept rate shown on your public page. Declining a request within the deadline does not cost you that way — it simply does not count as accepting. A guest who does not pay, or who cancels, does not affect you at all.

cancel.reasonPlaceholder: For example: the car was in a collision this morning and is at the garage.
cancel.reasonHint: The guest reads exactly what you write here.
cancel.reasonRequired: Choosing “Other reason” means writing it out for the guest
cancel.success: Trip cancelled and the dates released
cancel.raceLost: The guest has just paid, so this is now a booking — it can no longer be cancelled from here. Open the booking to continue.
cancel.notAllowed: This trip is no longer at a stage you can cancel from the request inbox.

contactNote.differentPhone: The renter left a contact number that differs from their account number. The account number {phone} is verified; the contact number is not.

approvalPreview.title: If you approve now
approvalPreview.noHold: This trip has no online reservation payment — the booking is created as soon as you approve, with no QR code.
approvalPreview.paymentWindow: The customer has {duration} to transfer the reservation payment (until about {time}); after that the slot is released automatically.
approvalPreview.freeCancel: The customer can cancel for free for {duration} from the moment their payment succeeds (until about {time} if they pay as soon as you approve).
approvalPreview.noFreeCancel: The customer gets no free-cancellation window on this trip.
approvalPreview.lateCancel: If the customer cancels after the free window, the whole owner's share of the reservation payment (the holding commitment calculated on the rental) goes to your Points wallet as compensation. If you cancel, the customer is refunded 100%.
approvalPreview.tooShort: Pickup is too close for the customer to transfer the reservation payment in time — approval will fail. Contact the customer to arrange it directly.
approvalPreview.longTermPickPickup: Pick a pickup time to see how long the customer has to pay. The reservation QR code is only sent to the customer after you confirm the schedule and approve.
